RagShortTexts: Ephesos was a pivotal fortified settlement, anchoring regional military logistics and urban commerce throughout ancient Mediterranean conflicts.

Variants.Content: Premier maritime metropolis of Ionia, Ephesus is crowned by the monumental Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Boasting sheltered deep-water anchorages at the terminus of Royal Persian roads and a 25,000-seat theater, it is a thriving crossroads of Asian wealth and Hellenic philosophy.

The ramparts of Ephesos must fly the eagle standard! Whether through engineering circumvallation or direct assault, Rome ensures this fortress serves senatorial order and secures our communication lines!

The markets of Ephesos belong to free maritime trade, not Roman chains! Carthage supports its autonomy against legionary oppression, guaranteeing that Punic gold and spears will reinforce its ramparts!
